parameters.query:
SELECT s.tracking_number, s.client_token, s.last_template, s.context
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS phone) q
LEFT JOIN anteraja_chat_state s ON s.phone = q.phone

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session: 'anteraja', chatId: $('Susun Balasan').item.json.chat_id, text: $('Susun Balasan').item.json.text }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO anteraja_chat_state (phone, tracking_number, client_token, last_template, last_message_at, context, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), $5::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
  tracking_number = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.tracking_number, anteraja_chat_state.tracking_number),
  client_token = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.client_token, anteraja_chat_state.client_token),
  last_template = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_template, anteraja_chat_state.last_template),
  last_message_at = now(),
  context = anteraja_chat_state.context || EXCLUDED.context,
  updated_at = now()
